scope: Byte-exact preservation of actual completed read-only clearance probe; no new run, no reconstructed completion receipt, no physical qualification

execution_record_semantics.executed_source: Actual previously executed file, copied without rewriting. Its archived contents keep the original E: workspace path.
execution_record_semantics.raw_results: Primary machine-written result of that exact distance probe.
execution_record_semantics.raw_log: Actual captured output of the completed probe.
execution_record_semantics.raw_summary: Separate post-run inline hash-verification and condensation of primary results; not a second distance run.
execution_record_semantics.raw_topology: Separate actual read-only inline traversal; source was inline, not this executed-probe file. Final driver independently rechecks current coverage.

algorithm: Exact saved-shape Solid-pair distances, sorted by actual tight-AABB lower bound; remaining pairs pruned only when lower bound exceeds best+1e-9 mm. Full material topology contains only Solid leaves. Original acceptance measured>=declared minimum-2e-5 mm retained.
